name: no-spec
description: Code change without an OpenSpec change; PR body must hold a No-spec justification line

name: hold
description: Owner veto: auto-merge stays off while this label is set

name: sensitive-content
description: Triage: the issue appears to contain secret material; a maintainer will delete it

name: security
description: Triage: possible vulnerability; report privately via security advisories

name: needs-triage
description: Triage: queued for maintainer review (automatic triage at capacity)

name: needs-repro
description: Needs a reproduction from the reporter
